description: This file contains the implementation of the TicketService interface, providing methods to manage Ticket entities via the TicketDAO within a Spring-based application.

classes.name: TicketServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of TicketService providing CRUD operations for Ticket entities.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a Ticket entity using the TicketDAO.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Ticket entities.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Ticket entity by its ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a Ticket by its ID.

methods.name: getTicketByTicketid
methods.description: Retrieves a Ticket entity based on its ticket ID property.

methods.name: getListBasedOnUserId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Ticket entities associated with a specific user ID.
